test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - General Awareness (Held on: 9 Aug 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a capacity-building scheme that was launched in 2020 for civil servants aimed at upgrading the post-recruitment training mechanism of the officers and employees at all levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Karmayogi**__.

__
 
• **Mission Karmayogi is a capacity-building scheme that was launched in 2020 for civil servants aimed at upgrading the post-recruitment training mechanism of the officers and employees at all levels**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The biggest bureaucratic reform initiative of '**Mission Karmayogi'** a National Program for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB) is to improve the human resource management practices of the government and use state-of-the-art infrastructure to enhance the capacity of civil servants.

 
 
• It is a **Technical Aided (IGOT Karmayogi) scheme** with comprehensive coverage of Central Government employees at all levels.
 
• Capacity building will involve civil servants in Indian culture while learning best practices across the globe.
 
• A Special Purpose Vehicle will be set up under Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mission Rakshak **is a campaign launched by ABPV to stop the spread of covid.

 
 
• Activities: Thermal screening, distribute masks, encourage people to get themselves vaccinated.
